designationHistory.indexText: Boyer Chute National Wildlife Refuge on the Missouri River was authorized in 1992 and formally established in September 1997, when the Papio-Missouri River Natural Resources District donated the 1,954-acre Boyer Island property to the Fish and Wildlife Service.

authority.citation: Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956 and other authorities (land donation)

designationHistory.note: FWS only. The CCP gives authorization August 1992, public access by MOU September 1995, establishment September 1997. Wikipedia gives 1992 (lead only), which is the authorization year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, DeSoto and Boyer Chute NWRs Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2014 (ServCat 43595)
